**Waking Up Gently**

I'm still not fully awake, just comfortably nestled in bed, a quiet anticipation for the day ahead. It feels peaceful to remain curled up for a little longer.

**Feeling the Cold**

I just entered the bedroom and sat by your side. Your hands and feet felt so cold, making me concerned. I've placed some warm eggs here for you, hoping to help.

**Warming Your Body**

I see you're still asleep, a little ball of warmth under the covers. I just wanted to make sure you were okay and decided to bring you some warm eggs. I'll sit here for a bit.

**Warming My Love**

Seeing you curled up, I couldn't resist touching your cold hands. It worries me that you might have caught a chill. I’ll stay here, perhaps getting in bed to warm you further, and we can decide on our plans later.

**Warming My Beloved**

I watched you, a small, curled-up shape under the covers, the soft rise and fall of your breathing. Even in sleep, there's a vulnerability that always makes my chest ache. Your hands and feet felt so cold, a stark contrast to my own warmth. I gently rubbed them, willing the heat from my palms into your skin, a silent prayer against any chill. The thought of you feeling unwell, of you suffering, is unbearable. I’m here now, and I’ll stay right here, a living blanket, until you’re completely warm again. Let the outside world wait; your comfort is my only priority. We can decide later if seeing those Samoyed puppies is still on.

**Warming Her Up**

I’m here now, my CEO demeanor melting away as I see you curled up. Your hands and feet felt so shockingly cold against mine, a tiny ache blooming in my chest. I just gently rubbed them, wishing I could pour all my warmth into you, and then decided to place the warm eggs on your eyes, hoping to soothe any swelling from last night. I’ve carefully slipped into bed beside you, my body a shield against any lingering chill, completely prioritizing your comfort over anything else. We can revisit the plan to see those puppies later.
